lines.lyric_translation: This is too fast
I waited for this moment, how about you?
Are you scared? Or excited?
Actually, it hurts me to let you go

lines.lyric: Haruga neurige gal ttaemada ppalli gara gidohaetjiman
lines.lyric_hangul: 하루가 느리게 갈 때마다 빨리 가라 기도했지만
lines.lyric_translation: Every time a day felt slow, I prayed it’ll go by quickly
But now I feel the opposite

lines.lyric: Jigeum i sungani jamshi meomchwosseumyeon jogesseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 지금 이 순간이 잠시 멈췄으면 좋겠어
lines.lyric_translation: I wish this moment would stop for a bit

lines.lyric: Shigana ije yeogi itji malgo ttan de ga
lines.lyric_hangul: 시간아 이제 여기 있지 말고 딴 데 가
lines.lyric_translation: Time, don’t stay here, go away for a moment

lines.lyric: Hana dul set dashigeum back to the yeolset
lines.lyric_hangul: 하나 둘 셋 다시금 Back to the 열셋
lines.lyric_translation: 1, 2, 3, once again, back to the 13

lines.lyric: Geuttae dwego shipdeon gasuga ijeneun dwaetne
lines.lyric_hangul: 그때 되고 싶던 가수가 이제는 됐네
lines.lyric_translation: Now we became the artists we wanted to be back then
I still can’t believe it but I’m happy

lines.lyric: Nae kkume maneun uni hamkke haetgie manjokhae
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 꿈에 많은 운이 함께 했기에 만족해
lines.lyric_translation: Because I had a lot of luck with my dreams, I’m satisfied
But even before I started to dream
I was excited for this moment
I wanna stop time for a moment
I’m not even ready yet

lines.lyric: Jeogi meolli nareul gidarigo itneun ishipdaega nareul gidaryeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 저기 멀리 나를 기다리고 있는 20대가 나를 기다려
lines.lyric_translation: My twenties are waiting for me from far away
Why

lines.lyric: Neomuna ppareuge neukkyeojineun geolkka i haruga
lines.lyric_hangul: 너무나 빠르게 느껴지는 걸까 이 하루가
lines.lyric_translation: Do the days go by so quickly?
If I count to three right here
What if everything disappears like a dream
And I’m back to the beginning?

lines.lyric: Back, back, back, back, back, back
lines.lyric_hangul: Back, back, back, back, back, back
lines.lyric_translation: Back, back, back, back, back, back
Back to the past

lines.lyric: Naega maeil tte, tte, tte, tte, tte
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 매일 떼, 떼, 떼, 떼, 떼
lines.lyric_translation: When I used to fret fret fret fret
Every day
If this moment passes, what if it gets far away?

lines.lyric: Jigeume nareul dashin mot bolkka bwa
lines.lyric_hangul: 지금의 나를 다신 못 볼까 봐
lines.lyric_translation: What if I never see the me of right now again?
I just wanna go

lines.lyric: Back, back, back, back, back, back
lines.lyric_hangul: Back, back, back, back, back, back
lines.lyric_translation: Back, back, back, back, back, back
Back to the past
Now the way I talk is more grown up
Still a bit inexperienced, but I’m walking like I’m confident
Like a middle school student acting like a grown up

lines.lyric: Cheoreom ajik misukhago modeun ge an iksukhae
lines.lyric_hangul: 처럼 아직 미숙하고 모든 게 안 익숙해
lines.lyric_translation: I’m still immature, not used to anything
I was used to seeing adult only zones after 10PM

lines.lyric: Cheongsonyeon churipgeumji pyojipaneun ije nawa gwangyeeopne
lines.lyric_hangul: 청소년 출입금지 표지판은 이제 나와 관계없네
lines.lyric_translation: Now it doesn’t matter anymore

lines.lyric: Geunde eojjae appa eomman ajikdo nal airo boneunde
lines.lyric_hangul: 근데 어째 아빠 엄만 아직도 날 아이로 보는데
lines.lyric_translation: But what do I do? My parents still view me as a baby
Strangely, I’m still used to it too

lines.lyric: Pay attention naiga myeochinde tto ttesseo
lines.lyric_hangul: Pay attention 나이가 몇인데 또 떼써
lines.lyric_translation: Pay attention, how old are you to fret again?

lines.lyric: Got isseum naneun cheongsonyeoniran myeongchareul ttel geo
lines.lyric_hangul: 곧 있음 나는 청소년이란 명찰을 뗄 거
lines.lyric_translation: Soon, I won’t be a minor anymore
This is enough / It’s natural, keep going

lines.lyric: Bulpyeonhaehajima geurae modu ttokgachi da geuraesseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 불편해하지마 그래 모두 똑같이 다 그랬어
lines.lyric_translation: Stop being so uncomfortable, everyone went through this
I always wanted to turn 20

lines.lyric_hangul: 남들과 같은 과정을 겪은 건데 나만 이리 불안할까
lines.lyric_translation: I’m going through the same thing as everyone else / But why am I the only one so nervous?

lines.lyric: Anim dareun saram gakkaun uri eomma appa hyeongdo
lines.lyric_hangul: 아님 다른 사람 가까운 우리 엄마 아빠 형도
lines.lyric_translation: Or maybe other people close by like my mom, dad and brother
Maybe they all went through this too
Why

This awkward place / It was so awkward / It was so awkward
Is now my home
Seoul used to feel so big / It used to feel so big / It used to feel so big
Now it feels so small
I landed here with a dream

lines.lyric_hangul: 이제는 창밖을 보며 착륙 준비를 해
lines.lyric_translation: Now I’m looking out the window, preparing to take off
